sal.basis: French pay is quoted as gross a year (brut annuel, usually written in K€), so per=year. Benchmarks recalled from France recruiter salary guides (Michael Page, Robert Half, Hays, Robert Walters, 2024-2026 editions) and APEC cadre data, NOT re-verified this session (web search budget exhausted, fetches blocked): Senior Financial Analyst / FP&A analyst (contrôleur de gestion confirmé or senior, 5-10 yrs) in Paris / Île-de-France about EUR 55-70k base, FP&A manager about EUR 70-90k; regional cities about 10-15% lower. Chosen current base EUR 60,000 gross a year (bonus excluded) = EUR 5,000 a month on a 12-month basis; f = 5,000 / 26,000 = 0.192, so Noura's 34,000 expectation maps to about EUR 6,540 a month (about EUR 78.5k a year), the top of the senior band and the entry to FP&A manager.

autoText.en: EU, EEA and Swiss citizens can work in France without a work permit.

rule.en: If you need a permit, we skip French jobs that say they can't sponsor one.
rule.ar: إذا كنت تحتاج إلى تصريح عمل، نتجاوز الوظائف في فرنسا التي تذكر أنها لا تستطيع التكفّل به.
rule.fr: Si vous avez besoin d'une autorisation de travail, nous écartons les offres en France qui précisent ne pas pouvoir la prendre en charge.

sensitive.notes: French anti-discrimination law (Code du travail L1132-1; Code pénal 225-1 and 225-2) bars selection on more than 25 criteria, including age, sex, family situation, nationality, origin, physical appearance and place of residence, and Code du travail L1221-6 limits what a recruiter may ask to information directly linked to the job. Photos were long standard on French CVs and still appear on many, so the photo is optional and never required (the 2006 anonymous-CV obligation was made optional in 2015). Application forms do not normally ask for gender, date of birth, nationality or marital status; the right-to-work card covers work authorisation.

legal.law: GDPR (RGPD) + Loi Informatique et Libertés (loi n° 78-17 du 6 janvier 1978)

privacy.en: Your data is protected under the GDPR and France's Loi Informatique et Libertés, overseen by the CNIL, and your CV only goes to employers you apply to.
privacy.ar: بياناتك محمية بموجب اللائحة الأوروبية العامة لحماية البيانات (GDPR) والقانون الفرنسي للمعلوماتية والحريات، تحت رقابة اللجنة الوطنية للمعلوماتية والحريات (CNIL)، ولا تُرسل سيرتك الذاتية إلا إلى جهات العمل التي تتقدّم إليها.
privacy.fr: Vos données sont protégées par le RGPD et la loi Informatique et Libertés, sous le contrôle de la CNIL, et votre CV n'est transmis qu'aux employeurs auprès desquels vous postulez.

renewal.en: Your plan renews automatically at the end of each period until you cancel, which takes a few clicks in Settings. We remind you before a 4- or 12-month plan renews, and under French consumer law you can withdraw within 14 days of subscribing.
renewal.ar: يتجدد اشتراكك تلقائياً في نهاية كل فترة إلى أن تلغيه، ويتم الإلغاء ببضع نقرات من الإعدادات. نذكّرك قبل تجديد خطة الأشهر الأربعة أو الاثني عشر شهراً، ووفقاً لقانون حماية المستهلك الفرنسي يحق لك الانسحاب خلال 14 يوماً من تاريخ الاشتراك.
renewal.fr: Votre abonnement se renouvelle automatiquement à la fin de chaque période jusqu'à sa résiliation, possible en quelques clics dans les Paramètres. Nous vous prévenons avant le renouvellement d'une formule de 4 ou 12 mois et, conformément au Code de la consommation, vous disposez de 14 jours pour vous rétracter après la souscription.

culture.notes: Mon-Fri. The legal working week is 35 hours; finance cadres are usually on a forfait jours (about 218 days a year) with RTT days off, and hybrid work with 2-3 office days is common in Paris. Pay is discussed as gross a year (brut annuel, often written in K€, e.g. 55-65 K€) and paid monthly at month end, in 12 or 13 instalments; packages add a variable bonus, profit-sharing (intéressement / participation), meal vouchers, mutuelle health cover and 50% of the public-transport pass. Cadres usually give 3 months' resignation notice under their collective agreement (about 1 month for non-cadres); employers sometimes agree an earlier exit. The trial period for cadres is up to 4 months, renewable once. CV: 1 page (2 at most for experienced profiles), in French for French employers, photo optional (still common), no date of birth or marital status needed; schools and degrees (grandes écoles, master's) carry weight. A short lettre de motivation is still often requested, less so via LinkedIn or Welcome to the Jungle. APEC is the reference job board and salary source for cadres.
